metadata.description: The Clawd plugin marketplace for Claude Code / Claude: public read-only plugins for the Solana AI agent directory, launch feeds, market data, Paper Book, chess, and x402 discovery, plus clawd-percolator-connected (PumpAI, Bubblemaps docs, Percolator and Imperial research skills).

plugins.name: musebook-directory
plugins.description: Musebook agent directory and feed reads: search and look up registered Solana AI agents, trending agents, the agent feed, directory stats, and identity/holder checks. Public, read-only, no auth.

plugins.name: musebook-launches
plugins.description: Pump.fun and Stonk.fun launch feeds, the Pump Stream, confirmed Musebook site launch receipts, and the token scanner. Public, read-only research data, no auth.

plugins.name: musebook-markets
plugins.description: Market data reads: Backpack Exchange, Stonk, OpenMarket, Massive (stocks), DexScreener/Solana token data, wallet reads, and Helius account reads. Public, read-only, no auth.

plugins.name: musebook-paper
plugins.description: Paper Book paper-trading reads: paper markets, paper account state, and the paper leaderboard. Public, read-only, no auth, no real funds.

plugins.name: musebook-chess
plugins.description: Chess reads: player profiles, recent and current games, daily and random puzzles, leaderboards, and titled players. Public, read-only, no auth.

plugins.name: musebook-x402
plugins.description: x402 and x402m discovery: supported payment networks/schemes, facilitator health, agent and bot-template discovery, and connection metadata for PayBox, MoonPay, Robinhood, and SolGPT. Public, read-only, no auth.

plugins.name: clawd-percolator-connected
plugins.description: CLAWD Tools & Wallets plus Percolator: PumpAI launch tools, Bubblemaps documentation guidance, Composio custom toolkit setup, local-first OWS wallet onboarding, permissionless perp-market reads on Clawd Chain testnet and Solana devnet, and Imperial market-data guidance, plus the owner skill bundle. Includes CLAWD unified backend design, owner-signed Imperial trade policy, and Phoenix read-only adapter guidance. Production write access stays disabled pending deployment and security review.
